approval.note: yerel test: transcript'te cravings (çoğul) geçiyor, çekim farkı, yanlış pozitif

segments.text: Although I knew sugar wasn't doing me any favors, I kept a cookie jar on my desk for
segments.englishExplanation: Admitting that keeping a cookie jar on the desk was unhealthy.
segments.turkishExplanation: Şekerin bana hiç faydası olmadığını bildiğim halde masamda bir kurabiye kavanozu bulundurdum,

segments.text: years. Last spring, I finally decided to cut down on it.
segments.englishExplanation: Mentioning that after years, they finally decided to reduce sugar intake.
segments.turkishExplanation: yıllarca. Geçen bahar nihayet şekeri azaltmaya karar verdim.

segments.text: Despite feeling tired and grumpy for the first week, I didn't give in.
segments.englishExplanation: Resisting sugar cravings despite feeling tired and irritable at first.
segments.turkishExplanation: İlk hafta yorgun ve huysuz hissetmeme rağmen pes etmedim.

segments.text: Even though my colleagues kept bringing cake to the office, I made a simple rule.
segments.englishExplanation: Setting a personal rule despite colleagues bringing cakes.
segments.turkishExplanation: İş arkadaşlarım ofise sürekli pasta getirse de basit bir kural koydum.

segments.text: Fruit first, dessert only at weekends.
segments.englishExplanation: Describing the rule of prioritizing fruit and limiting dessert to weekends.
segments.turkishExplanation: Önce meyve, tatlı sadece hafta sonları.

segments.text: In spite of all my doubts, the cravings faded within a month. The surprising part?
segments.englishExplanation: Noticing that sugar cravings went away within a month despite doubts.
segments.turkishExplanation: Tüm şüphelerime rağmen tatlı krizlerim bir ay içinde kayboldu. Şaşırtıcı kısım mı?

segments.englishExplanation: Stating that food now tastes sweeter naturally.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yiyeceklerin tadı artık daha tatlı geliyor.

segments.text: Though I still love chocolate, it no longer runs my day.
segments.englishExplanation: Concluding that chocolate no longer controls their daily life.
segments.turkishExplanation: Çikolatayı hâlâ sevsem de artık günümü o yönetmiyor.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To reduce the amount or quantity of something you consume or do.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir şeyin tüketimini veya miktarını azaltmak anlamına gelir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I am trying to cut down on caffeine this month.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Bu ay kafein tüketimini azaltmaya çalışıyorum.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To stop resisting a craving, temptation, or pressure.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir isteğe veya baskıya direnmeyi bırakıp pes etmek anlamına gelir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: She wanted a doughnut, but she didn't give in.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Canı çörek istedi ama pes etmedi.

quiz.question: In the video, what does the speaker mean by saying 'I didn't give in'?

options.text: They did not surrender to their cravings.
They did not share their snacks with colleagues.
They did not feel tired during the first week.
They did not agree to follow their diet rule.

issues.message: "craving" transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — çekim/inflection farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
